# MBTI Cognitive Function Test — /ai/

> Machine-readable interface for the MBTI Cognitive Function Test. Everything here is static, public and key-free; start with the specification, then fetch questions, then score.

## For AI agents
- [Specification](https://3310zx.github.io/mbti-test/ai/spec.md): the single authoritative document — endpoints, 38 questions, Likert scale, exact scoring algorithm, JSON schema, likert / forced modes, self-checks and a copy-paste prompt.
- [Questions JSON](https://3310zx.github.io/mbti-test/ai/questions.json): version 1.0, scale map, dimension map and all 38 questions (id, dim, dir, en, zh).
- [Score endpoint](https://3310zx.github.io/mbti-test/ai/score.html): GET ?a=3,2,5,... (38 integers 1-6, ',' or '-' separated; optional &lang=zh) returns result JSON; errors are JSON too, HTTP stays 200.
- [Human landing page](https://3310zx.github.io/mbti-test/ai/index.html): what this is, how to use it, copy-ready prompt.
- [Agent card](https://3310zx.github.io/mbti-test/agent-card.json): A2A-style capability declaration for the mbti-test skill.
- [Site index](https://3310zx.github.io/mbti-test/llms.txt): top-level site index.

## Notes
- All endpoints are GET and CORS-open static files (GitHub Pages). No authentication, no cookies.
- The test is entertainment / self-reflection material, not a clinical psychological assessment.
